subject: Skill-gap triage and backfill plan — QBR readiness
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Skill-gap triage and backfill plan — QBR readiness

Team —

Attaching a consolidated tracker for QBR prep (QBR_headcount_tracker_2027Q3.xlsx) and a lightweight skill-gap matrix (skill-gap-matrix.pdf). We need to lock decisions on the 8 open reqs we flagged last sprint so the TA partners can start sourcing next week. The ask from GTM for July launch means any open backend/infra slots we don’t commit to will likely be deprioritized until Oct.

Proposal (recommended priorities):
- Priority A: 2x Backend SDE (backfill from infra incident hires), 1x Senior Reliability Eng — immediate approval requested
- Priority B: 1x Data Platform Eng (new role, critical to telemetry), 1x PM (observe go/no-go after A hires)
- Hold: 1x Frontend (low usage), 1x Product Designer (can be contractor)

Please review the tracker and call out any serious objections by EOD Monday. Martina in TA warned that if we don’t brief TalentPartners by Tue they’ll drop our slate for higher priority clients.

Action items:
- Each of you: highlight any req you want moved between buckets (A/B/Hold) — inline on sheet
- Laura: confirm budget carve for Priority A vs. reallocate from Q3 contractor line
- Vivek: confirm runway/contractor conversion plan for Reliability role

Attachments: QBR_headcount_tracker_2027Q3.xlsx (xlsx), skill-gap-matrix.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Skill-gap triage and backfill plan — QBR readiness

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick notes after scanning the matrix:
- I support Priority A for 2x Backend and 1x Reliability, but we should convert one contractor on the stack to a perm for the reliability role (saves ramp time). I estimate we have budget for 1 conversion this quarter, not 2.
- For Data Platform Eng (Priority B): can we combine the observability scope into the senior reliability role so we can delay hiring a full-time data platform person until Oct? That preserves Q3 runway.
- Frontend and Designer: put on hold and use contractor pool for immediate UI fixes.

I'll annotate the tracker with the contractor-conversion candidate and circle back with TA. If Laura confirms budget reallocation, we can brief TalentPartners tomorrow.

— Vivek
Sr. Director, Infrastructure

Subject: Re: Skill-gap triage and backfill plan — QBR readiness

Rafael / Vivek —

Thanks — good work pulling this together. A couple of constraints from finance: we can reallocate up to 60% of the Q3 contractor budget to perm conversions, but anything beyond that needs exec sign-off. That means we can convert one contractor as Vivek suggested, but not two without escalation.

Two clarifying asks before I lock Priority A:
1) Can the PM role be scoped as a fractional PM (0.5 FTE) to cover the initial launch coordination? If so, we can pause a full PM hire now and revisit after the launch.
2) For the Backend SDEs: are these backfills for headcount we already had approved in Q2, or new uplifts? If they are uplifts, we need a short memo for the CFO for headcount increase.

I updated the tracker to mark the PM as "0.5 FTE candidate" pending product confirmation.

Laura
Head of Finance & Ops
Redwood Inference

Folks —

Recap and decisions (finalized):
- Approve Priority A hires: 2x Backend SDE (backfills), 1x Senior Reliability Eng (convert 1 contractor)
- Priority B: delay Data Platform Eng until Oct, scope PM as 0.5 FTE for launch coordination
- Hold: Frontend and Product Designer; use contractors for short-term work

Kelly / Tanya: please kick off sourcing for the three Priority A slots. TA brief: convert contractor id "CTR-214" for the Reliability position; start external search for two Backend SDE backfills (reqs to be created under JIRA: HRREQ-314).

Attachments (re-sent): QBR_headcount_tracker_2027Q3.xlsx (xlsx) — final annotated, skill-gap-matrix.pdf (pdf)

Next steps:
- Kelly: send slate by 7/1; include 2-3 screened candidates per role
- Laura: I’ll follow up with a short headcount memo for CFO on the two Backend uplifts if required
- Vivek: confirm contractor conversion paperwork with TA

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
